## Changes

- Adds composer status controls for plan mode, auto-review, fast mode, model, reasoning effort, and context usage.
- Moves runtime controls out of the toolbar and refines the composer so the input and status row share one Obsidian-styled frame.
- Adds a rename slash command for renaming the active thread from the composer.
- Improves keyboard navigation and layout stability for stream details, usage diagnostics, diff actions, and Threads view renaming.
